resources.name: Orthorhombic YAP crystal structure

access.notes: Space group Pnma, a≈5.33 Å, b≈7.38 Å, c≈5.18 Å. Reference [27] (Diehl & Brandt, Mat. Res. Bull. 10, 85, 1975); also available from ICSD.

resources.name: α-Al2O3 (corundum) crystal structure

access.notes: Rhombohedral, a≈4.759 Å, c≈12.986 Å from [29]; standard ICSD structure.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source DFT code (version 7.x or later recommended). The agent should install pw.x and associated tools.

resources.notes: Replaces the paper's proprietary CASTEP code with an open-source equivalent.

resources.name: SSSP pseudopotentials (PBE) for Y, Al, O

access.notes: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials from the SSSP efficiency library (e.g., Y.pbe-spn-rrkjus_psl.0.2.UPF, Al.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF, O.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.0.1.UPF). Use PBE exchange-correlation functional.

resources.notes: Equivalent to the ultrasoft pseudopotentials with GGA-PW91 used in the paper; PBE is the standard GGA replacement.
